title: Recover temporary network sessions without undoing permanent Disconnect
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md, docs/design/SWARM-BRIEF-v0.md, docs/design/RULES-SPEC-v1.md and the listed sourceRefs before editing. The imported Rules Spec v1 is the canonical engine contract; the earlier prototype/T01-T10 interfaces are baseline compatibility, not current gameplay rules. Do not restore approval votes, Repair/Sabotage buttons, Witness or five-node tracks. Preserve original IP and engine independence from Firebase/UI/Node. Edit only ownership; publish APIs only through explicitly owned package entrypoints, preserving baseline exports. Use original synthetic fixtures, scoped tests/lint/typecheck and npm run check. Do not commit, push, open PRs, spawn agents, provision/deploy services, access credentials or alter swarm budget. Implement verified temporary network reconnect/presence with session generations and injected trusted time. Revalidate membership from invisible session proof rather than alias/avatar/room hint. Treat transient transport loss separately from Rules permanent Disconnect: network recovery does not restore a permanently removed player active/vote/Crew/chat/private-diagnostic rights. Expired old disconnect callbacks cannot replace a new connection generation. The online match keeps its authoritative deadline while any client is backgrounded; missed activity is completed by A065,not a local pause. Apply the documented safe retained/cleared session behavior; host failover policy remains a narrow explicit source decision,not automatic election.
acceptance: Refresh/background/network return restores the same verified participant without a duplicate seat or an account/login flow.
Copied aliases,room codes or session hints cannot take over another participant.
A power-Disconnected participant remains a silent spectator after reconnect and receives no private diagnostics or action authority.
Tests cover stale generations,late callbacks,deadline continuity,failed revalidation and private-state isolation with injected clocks.
